title: Rabbi Yirmeyah ben Elazar, a Tanna

paragraphs: Bar Kappara spoke in his name in [Vayikra Rabbah 20:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.20.8), [Tanchuma Buber, Acharei Mot 7](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tanchuma_Buber%2C_Achrei_Mot.7.2), and [Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 26:8 (Hyman cites folio 172b)](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesikta_DeRav_Kahana.26.8).[^2]

In [Kohelet Rabbah 1:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Kohelet_Rabbah.1.7.9), Rabbi Yirmeyah ben Elazar says: “The Holy One, blessed be He, will renew the radiance of the faces of the righteous.” See Radal’s glosses there: Rabbi said it in his name to Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yose.
And we find in [Sotah 4a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.4a.3) Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah (a Tanna); perhaps he is his son.[^1]

notes.text: The possible father-son relationship in the closing sentence is Hyman’s conjecture. Radal remains the supplied commentator label.

The linked Vayikra Rabbah, Tanchuma Buber and Pesikta transmit Bar Kappara’s teaching about Aaron’s sons in Rabbi Yirmeyah’s name. The linked Kohelet Rabbah gives the teaching about the radiance of the righteous. Hyman cites Radal for a further transmission. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2230&lang=en) distinguishes two sages named Rabbi Yirmeyah ben Elazar.
